$description: Connect design tokens (specification 018 design proposal). Generated by build-tokens.mjs from tokens.source.mjs; do not edit. Format: Design Tokens Community Group 2025.10.

surface-canvas.$description: Application background behind every card and panel.

surface-raised.$description: Cards, tables, the sidebar and the top bar. Charts are drawn on this surface.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells inside a raised surface: table headers, code blocks, input groups.

surface-hover.$description: Hover wash on rows, menu items and ghost buttons.

surface-pressed.$description: Pressed state of the same elements.

surface-selected.$description: Selected navigation item, selected row, active segment.

text-primary.$description: Headings, values and body copy on every surface.

text-secondary.$description: Supporting copy, table cells of lower rank, field hints.

text-tertiary.$description: Meta lines, axis labels, placeholders. Still 4.5:1 on canvas, raised and sunken.

text-disabled.$description: Disabled labels only. Exempt from contrast rules.

text-brand.$description: Links and the label of the active navigation item.

text-on-primary.$description: Label on action-primary and on the brand tile.

border-subtle.$description: Dividers inside a card, table row rules.

border-strong.$description: Emphasized dividers, the selected segment outline.

border-control.$description: Inputs, selects, checkboxes and radios. At least 3:1 on canvas and raised.

border-focus.$description: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset in the surface color.

border-brand.$description: Outline of a selected card or tile.

action-primary.$description: Primary button, checked controls, progress fill.

status-success-fg.$description: Text and icons for a confirmed or healthy state.

status-success-bg.$description: Tint behind a success badge or banner.

status-success-border.$description: Outline of a success badge or banner.

status-warning-fg.$description: Text and icons for partial, stale or attention states.

status-warning-bg.$description: Tint behind a warning badge or banner.

status-warning-border.$description: Outline of a warning badge or banner.

status-warning-solid.$description: Solid warning dot or fill. Always paired with dark text.

status-danger-fg.$description: Text and icons for failures and blocking problems.

status-danger-bg.$description: Tint behind a danger badge or banner.

status-danger-border.$description: Outline of a danger badge or banner.

status-info-fg.$description: Text and icons for provisional or informational states.

status-info-bg.$description: Tint behind an info badge or banner.

status-info-border.$description: Outline of an info badge or banner.

status-neutral-fg.$description: Text and icons for missing, unsupported or not-synced values.

status-on-solid.$description: Label on the success, danger and info solids.

status-warning-on-solid.$description: Label on the warning solid in both themes.

viz-seq-3.$description: Sequential ramp. First step allowed for ordinal marks.

viz-div-mid.$description: Diverging scale midpoint: reads as nothing.

viz-1.$description: Categorical chart slot (teal). The slot order is fixed.
